DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請者のお名前を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me check the applicant's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 登録はこの長い名前です。会社の申込書では短く書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録名と申込略名の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My registered name is this long one. I use a shorter name on the company's application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the registered and abbreviated application names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明書は登録内容に基づきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certificates are based on the registered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社に合わせて、短い名前の証明書を作れるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先に合わせ任意変更できないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I cannot have a certificate made with the short name just to match the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that you cannot change it freely to suit the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。表記が違う場合は、提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. If the writing differs, check with the place receiving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の用紙を見せます。私の登録名と同じ人だと分かる資料が必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同一人照合の必要を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show the company's form. I want to ask whether documents are needed to show that this is the same person as my registered name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the need to match identities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先に確認する内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's organize what you need to check with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録名、申込名、生年月日を示して、申込側を直す必要があるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先へ示す情報と質問を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the registered name, application name, and date of birth, and ask whether the application needs correcting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the information and questions for the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それが確認できてから、必要な証明書を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once that is confirmed, you can choose the necessary certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は勝手に名前を省略せず、登録名を控えて会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 省略せず会社確認まで発行を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will not shorten the name myself. I will note my registered name and contact the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not abbreviate; wait for company confirmation before issuance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行は確認後にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Consult us about issuance after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査結果の用紙についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the test-results sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「陰性」とあります。全部の検査に問題がないという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つの陰性表示が全検査の判断を示すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says “negative.” Does that mean there are no problems with all the tests?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one negative result judges all tests. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの項目の結果かを確認する必要があります。診療上の説明は担当に伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check which item it refers to. Let's ask the medical staff for the clinical explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上から三番目の項目です。別の欄には、まだ結果待ちと書いてありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示の項目と別の結果待ち欄を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the third item from the top. Another field said the result was still pending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the item and another pending-result field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つの結果と、まだ結果が出ていない項目を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check this result separately from the items that have not yet produced results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この言葉だけで、すべて終わったと考えてはいけないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一語だけで検査全体終了と解釈しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should not assume everything is finished based on this word alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that a single word does not mean the entire testing is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 全体の判断や次の対応は、診療担当へ質問してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the clinical staff about the overall assessment and next steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三番目の結果の意味と、結果待ちの項目をいつ確認するか、二つ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当該結果の意味と未確定項目の確認時期を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to ask two things: what the third result means, and when to check the pending items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the result means and when to check the unconfirmed items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご質問を伝えます。用紙をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will pass on those questions. Please keep the sheet as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 結果待ちの欄を消さず、この用紙を見せて説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙を保ち診療担当の説明を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not erase the pending field. I will show this sheet and receive the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the sheet and say you will hear the clinical staff's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当の説明を確認してから、次の予定をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check their explanation before discussing your next arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メールで何を求められましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What did the email ask you to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アカウントの本人確認で、身分証の写真を返信するよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 身分証写真の返信要求を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to reply with a photo of my ID to verify my account's identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the request to reply with an ID photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は送信しましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 添付まではしましたが、まだ送っていません。下書きに残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 添付済みだが未送信と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I attached it but have not sent it yet. It is still in my drafts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is attached but not sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信前と送信済みでは状況が違います。差出人を確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before and after sending are different situations. Have you confirmed the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前はサービス名ですが、普段の通知とアドレスが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示名と送信元の不一致を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The displayed name is the service name, but the address differs from the usual notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the mismatch between the display name and sender address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのメールへの返信ではなく、正規の窓口で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check through the official contact rather than replying to that email.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 公式アプリの問い合わせを使います。下書きを誤送信しないよう、添付を外しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 公式窓口へ確認し誤送信を防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the official app's inquiry function. I will remove the attachment to avoid accidentally sending the draft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check through the official contact and prevent accidental sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談用にメールの内容と受信時刻を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the email's content and receipt time for the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内容は保存しました。写真を送っていないことを明確にして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容を保存して未提供の状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have saved the content. I will make clear when seeking advice that I have not sent the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save the content and report that it has not been provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作した範囲を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask in order what operations you performed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物のサイズは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you checked the parcel size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中の箱は三十センチです。小さい料金になると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商品寸法を荷物サイズとして申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The box inside is thirty centimeters. I think it will qualify for the smaller rate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the product dimensions as the parcel size. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送では梱包した外側の大きさを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For shipping, we check the outside size after packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緩衝材を巻いたので、外側は大きくなっています。中身の寸法だけでは決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 梱包後の外寸が必要と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrapped it in cushioning, so the outside is larger. We cannot decide from the contents' dimensions alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the packaged outside dimensions are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。三辺と重量を測ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We will measure the three sides and weight and let you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 測ってください。料金を小さくするために緩衝材を全部取るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護材を保ち実測を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please measure it. I want to avoid removing all the cushioning just to get a lower rate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the protective material and request measurement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 品物を保護できる梱包が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Packaging that protects the item is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このまま測った料金を聞いてから送るか決めます。外側の突き出した部分も含みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 突起の扱いと見積後の判断を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hear the rate measured as it is before deciding whether to send it. Do the parts sticking out count too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about protrusions and deciding after the estimate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 含めて確認します。テープで収められる所は整えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will include them. Let's tidy the parts that can be secured with tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 角を整えました。保護は残したまま、仕上がった箱で見積もってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外形を整えた箱で料金確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have tidied the corners. Please estimate using the finished box with the protection still in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the rate for the box with its outside shape tidied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の寸法と重量で料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will give the rate based on its current dimensions and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約する振込日は、この日でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this date all right for the scheduled transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。支払期限が日曜日なので、その日に届けばよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休日の支払期限に合わせた予約を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The payment deadline is Sunday, so it only needs to arrive that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request scheduling for a payment deadline on a holiday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約日と処理の時刻、相手口座への反映は確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the scheduled date, processing time, and when it appears in the recipient's account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜日を選べても、期限内に届くと保証されるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選択可能日と着金保証を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So being able to select Sunday does not guarantee it arrives before the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a selectable date from guaranteed arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。利用方法と金融機関の条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. We will explain the usage method and financial institutions' conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先方の案内には金曜日までに手続きとあります。日曜だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方の事前手続き指定を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient's instructions say to complete the procedure by Friday. I was only looking at Sunday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reread the recipient's earlier-procedure requirement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その指定なら、実行日を早めることもご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: With that requirement, consider bringing the execution date forward too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜日の予定に変えたいです。変更後の画面で日付も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実行予定を早め変更日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to change the schedule to Friday. I will check the date on the changed screen too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move the scheduled execution earlier and check the changed date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ実行前の予約ですので、設定方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is still a booking before execution, so we will show you the settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。完了した時には、予定日ではなく実際の処理結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定だけでなく実処理結果を見ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. When it is complete, I will check the actual processing result, not just the planned date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check actual processing, not only the plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。結果の確認方法も合わせてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will explain how to check the result too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a bag with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日はありません。この袋を買えば、袋持参の特典が付きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入袋が持参扱いになるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not today. If I buy this bag, will I get the benefit for bringing a bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a purchased bag counts as a brought bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このお会計では持参した袋ではありません。特典の条件はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this checkout, it is not a bag you brought. Here are the benefit's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋を買う代金と、持参の特典は別なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋代と特典条件を分けて理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the cost of buying a bag and the bring-your-own benefit are separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the bag charge and benefit conditions separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。袋の購入は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Do you need to buy a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚お願いします。重い瓶がありますが、この大きさで大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要枚数と重い品への適合を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One, please. I have heavy bottles; is this size all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the quantity needed and suitability for heavy items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量と耐荷重の案内をご覧ください。無理に詰めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look at the capacity and load-limit guidance. Do not overfill it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 瓶二本とパンなので、瓶は袋へ、パンは手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容量に合わせ品物を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two bottles and bread, so I will put the bottles in the bag and carry the bread in my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the items to suit the capacity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その袋を購入分として計上します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will charge that bag as a purchased item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。特典は付かない金額で払います。次から袋を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特典なしの会計を了承し次回持参を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will pay the amount without the benefit. Next time I will bring a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept checkout without the benefit and decide to bring a bag next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋もレシートでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please check the bag on the receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 売店をお探しですか。今日は営業を終えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the shop? It has closed for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうでしたか。飲み物がなくなったので、もう一周する前に買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲料不足と周回前の購入希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I see. I have run out of drinks and want to buy one before another lap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lack drinks and want to buy before another lap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理棟のそばに飲料の販売機があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a drinks vending machine near the administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では先にそちらへ行きます。ここから離れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 補給先までの距離を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will go there first. Is it far from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the distance to the resupply point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この園路をまっすぐ進んだ所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is straight along this park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布に小銭がありません。使える支払方法が分からなければ、管理棟で聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小銭不足のため決済方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no coins in my wallet. If I do not know which payment methods work, can I ask at the administration building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about payment methods because you lack coins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内できます。必要なら散歩を短くして退園することもお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can advise you. If necessary, also consider shortening your walk and leaving the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。飲み物を確保できなければ一周はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確保できなければ散歩を短くすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If I cannot get drinks, I will not do another lap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to shorten the walk if drinks are unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 販売機のそばに休める所もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is also a resting place near the vending machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこで一度休み、飲み物と体調を確認してから続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補給後に休んで継続を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest there and check my drinks and how I feel before deciding whether to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Rest after resupplying and judge whether to continue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲でどうぞ。管理棟へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please stay within your limits. Head toward the administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運転状況のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about train services?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この券で乗る予定でしたが、別の路線から行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延で経路変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I intended to travel with this ticket, but want to take another line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a route change because of delays. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別経路での切符の扱いは、今の案内と券の種類で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check how the ticket can be used on another route against the current instructions and ticket type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ目的地ならそのまま使えると思いました。まだ別の券は買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入のまま同一目的地の認識を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it could be used unchanged if the destination was the same. I have not bought another ticket yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your same-destination assumption while still not having purchased. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご購入の券を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see the ticket you bought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これです。振替の対象か、買い直す必要があるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ち券の振替対象と買直しを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. Please tell me whether it is eligible for alternative transport or needs to be repurchased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your ticket qualifies for rerouting and whether repurchase is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が現在の取扱いをご案内します。先に別の改札へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain current handling. Do not go through another ticket gate first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。余計な支払いになる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他改札へ進まず処理を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. I want to check before making an unnecessary payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not proceed to another gate; wait for handling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。この券の処理をしてから別経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed it. After processing this ticket, we will guide you on the other route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。処理の控えも受け取り、別路線の券は案内後に買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の券の処理と控え受取後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will also receive the processing record and buy the other line's ticket after the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy after the original ticket's processing and receipt of its record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順にご案内します。元の券をお預かりして確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will guide you in order. We will take the original ticket to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の際に希望されることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を忘れやすいので、スマホで録音したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き直すための録音希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forget explanations easily, so I want to record them on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request recording so you can listen again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録音の扱いは担当へ確認します。どの目的で使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check recording arrangements with the person in charge. What will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で聞き直すためです。ネットへ出すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私的な目的と公開予定のなさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Listening again at home. I do not intend to post it online.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain private use and no plans to publish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を予約に添えますが、録音できると今はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will add your request to the booking, but cannot promise now that recording is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。できない場合は、重要な点を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 録音不可時の書面案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If it is not allowed, could I have the important points written on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about written guidance if recording is not allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談内容に応じて担当へお尋ねください。ご自身でメモを取る準備もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the person in charge according to the consultation content. Please also prepare to take your own notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ノートを持って来ます。聞き取れなければその場で要点を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分のメモと要点確認を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will bring a notebook. If I do not catch something, I will check the main points there and then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare your notes and confirmation of key points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。録音するなら開始前に担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If recording, check with the person in charge before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約の希望欄には目的も書いてください。返事があるまで録音は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始前の担当確認を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please write the purpose in the request field too. I will not start recording until I have an answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to check with the person in charge before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録方法のご希望としてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass this on as your preferred way of keeping a record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の忘れ物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this something left behind after your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。検査の説明用紙を持って出たはずですが、かばんにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査説明用紙の不在を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I took the test-information sheet with me, but it is not in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your test-information sheet is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察室以外で用紙を出した場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you take it out anywhere other than the consultation room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計の前に待合の机で読みました。そこに置いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に読んだ場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I read it at the waiting-room table before paying. I may have left it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say where you last read it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付で確認します。ほかの方の用紙を自分で探して開かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception will check. Do not search through and open other people's papers yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私の名前が書いてあるかも確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人名義の確認を係員へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Please also check whether my name is on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to verify that it bears your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。次の検査日も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask the person in charge. Do you also know your next test date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週木曜日です。見つからなければ、必要な準備をもう一度説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査日と再説明の希望を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next Thursday. If it cannot be found, I would like the necessary preparations explained again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the test date and request another explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それも診療科へ伝えます。準備内容は受付で推測してご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the clinical department that too. Reception will not guess and advise you about preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。検査まで日があるので、説明を受けた用紙を確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 推測せず正式な説明を確認して帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. There is still time before the test, so I will check the sheet with the explanation before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not guess; confirm the official explanation before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できるまでお待ちください。担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait until we can confirm. The person in charge will advise you.
